methodology.unit: whole independent TRAIN episode; four paired suffix repeats nested within source
methodology.paired_comparison: rescue=count(candidate=1,baseline=0); harm=count(candidate=0,baseline=1); net gain pp=100*(rescue-harm)/(4*N); source sign from its four-repeat total difference
methodology.raw_dedup: Rebuilt canonical first-slot aliases independently from little-endian float32 raw 10x4 command bytes; identical aliases must have identical four labels
methodology.gain_weights: BCE group weights except every alias of a0 has zero weight
methodology.pair_weights: Each of five declared +/- pairs receives 1 / multiplicity of its distinct unordered raw-group pair; same-group pairs receive zero
methodology.loss_reduction: Weighted candidate/pair means inside each source, then equal source mean. Group/replicate counts are not independent source counts.
methodology.aggregation: Independent NumPy implementation; no old summarizer functions imported or called
methodology.confidence_intervals: Not recomputed in this bounded point-estimate cross-check
methodology.filter: No train outcome, alarm, Q or benefit filters; all 300+300 retained; actual selection strata are descriptive
methodology.replay_limits: Underlying branch/seeding/seals were previously audited; this check verifies sealed train packs and their internal raw/label/alias/weight identities, not a new rollout replay

interpretation_limits: Training labels describe candidate-bank supervision, not newly trained final A/B policy effectiveness or independent validation.
Round1 and round2 use distinct episodes and different generation critics; their rate/gain differences are not paired evidence that changing the teacher caused improvement.
The joint 600-source result is descriptive pooling of two generation distributions, not a deployable policy winner.
Any-candidate benefit/harm and informative-source counts measure observed supervision only; no outcome oracle is claimed.
Four suffix repeats improve within-source paired labels; effective sample size is 300/300/600 sources, not 1200/1200/2400 independent episodes.
Actual alarm, scheduled and fallback subgroups are training selection strata and do not replace a complete deployment evaluation denominator.
